answer_1.quote: We propose Interest Augmented Multimodal Generator (I-AM-G) for item personalization.
answer_1.outputs: personalized images such as movie posters, news thumbnails, and outfit designs based on user interests

answer_2.quote: For image quality, we use (1) Structural Similarity (SSIM) and (2) Learned Perceptual Image Patch Similarity (LPIPS) to measure the similarity between two images. Moreover, we use (3) CLIP Score to calculate the similarity between the text description of the item and the generated result as the text-image fidelity.

answer_3.quote: Leveraging the powerful capabilities and aesthetic judgment of ChatGPT 4o, we make it rank the generated results. We used a prompt-based approach (details in Appendix C) to ask it to rank the input images.

answer_4.quote: To investigate whether users truly appreciate the generated movie posters, news posters, and outfits by I-AM-G, we conducted a human study (see Appendix F for questionnaire) where participants were asked to score the generation results with ranks.
answer_4.guideline: Each questionnaire presented the three generated images and the original image for a specific item in a completely shuffled order. Participants were required to score the item images from 1 to 4, and score lower ranks to those they deemed better.
